current.text: Ty Jerome is the projected starting point guard and has started both preseason games. Spencer is projected to come off the bench.
The Memphis guard group is crowded with Javon Small, Ty Jerome, Scotty Pippen Jr. and Campazzo. Coach Iisalo is expected to use an 11 or 12 man rotation.
Last season he shot under 36% from three and 64% at the rim, and he gained from absences on the Memphis roster.
His minutes are uncertain. Several players ahead of him would need to be out before he matters in fantasy.
Memphis plays 4-4-4 games in our playoff weeks (season ending March 28) and has only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He is a low-usage passer who adds assists but does not create much offense for himself.
He is a very efficient shooter from mid-range and three, but he takes few threes.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace with short stints and keeps minutes down, which limits bench guards' totals.

note: Both sites give him 0 USD in value. He ranks 229 on Yahoo and 143 on ESPN, so he sits at the edge of our 144-player draft pool or outside it, and he should not be drafted. His value is assists (5.6 per game last season), strong FT% on low volume and few turnovers. He has no weak category, but his points, rebounds, steals and blocks are low. Watch him on waivers early in the season, in case Ty Jerome or other Memphis guards miss time and he moves into the 24-minute role he played last season.
